title: Backend & Systems Engineer Roadmap
description: A progression from language-level internals (C, C++, Java memory models and concurrency) through Go-based service concurrency and API design, into distributed-systems architecture and system design — for engineers moving from application-level backend work into deep systems and platform engineering.
targetRole: Backend Engineer / Systems Engineer / Senior Software Engineer
prerequisites: Working proficiency in at least one systems language (C, C++, Go, or Java)
Basic understanding of REST APIs and networking

sequencedCourses.courseTitle: C++ Internals From Scratch: Memory, Ownership, Concurrency, and the STL
Java Internals From Scratch: JVM, Memory, Concurrency, and Production Services
Mastering Go Concurrency: Goroutines, Channels, and Select Patterns

competencies: Language-level internals: memory management, ownership, and concurrency models in C, C++, and Java
Go concurrency primitives: goroutines, channels, select, and the runtime scheduler
Secure, production-grade REST/gRPC API design and session security
Building and deploying resilient Go microservices with Docker and Kubernetes
Domain-driven design for decomposing microservice boundaries
Distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, partitioning, and system design tradeoffs
